name: pf-mod-autoaim
about: mod-autoaim against the built packages autoaim, qol instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Auto aim (mods/autoaim, on core's aim hooks HWP/Core/Aim.as) through the fix_autoaim bot, in town as a ranger with a target dummy 80 px south, on the mouse path (autoaim.mode 2; the lab has no gamepad): holding Skill 1 fires Marked Shot at the dummy by itself (auto fire); with auto fire off the reticle snaps onto the dummy and nothing fires; a 90 degree cone pointed north does not pick the dummy and pointed south does; with nothing pressed the ready Marked Shot casts itself at the dummy (auto skill); mode off does neither; the Plus tab shows the four rows (with colors and weaponswap loaded, all nine rows fit) and its mode row cycles the setting. Shots: autoaim-snap, autoaim-options.

allow: Resource name hash conflict in package 'mods/(HWP-[a-z0-9]+|HammerwatchPlus-All)(-gamelab)?\.bin' for file
